jessica: Heads-up: planning to promote feature-branch overlay to staging today. Quick preflight — k8s secret paths + TF var changes. Anyone on call?

carl: on it. which overlay dir? feature-x or ff/feature-x?

jessica: it's under overlays/staging/feature-sessions (new). TF change in modules/secrets: adding ssm path /rdrw/staging/session-service. PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/pulls/1234

jessica: ```terraform
resource "aws_ssm_parameter" "session_secret" {
  name  = "/rdrw/staging/session-service"
  type  = "SecureString"
  value = var.session_secret
}
```

devops-bot: CI check: build ✅, unit tests ✅, infra-lint ✅. Image built: registry.redwood/inference/session-service:sha-abc123

mike: Heads-up: secretmanager -> ssm mapping still pending from the last migration. Need to ensure the staging IAM role has ssm:GetParameters and kms:Decrypt for alias/rdrw-staging.

sara: If we change secret path, kustomize overlay needs to remap env var: SESSION_SECRET_PATH. Example patch: `envFrom.secretRef.name: session-service-staging`

carl: I'll run a terraform plan and a k8s server-side dry-run. Thinking we should canary 10% for 30m then promote. @jessica ? :thumbsup:

jessica: :thumbsup: let's canary 10% for 30m, then promote. Carl, assign me the PR to review, I'll check TF and k8s manifests.

troy: also FYI prod overlay uses SSE-KMS key alias `alias/rdrw-prod`, staging uses `alias/rdrw-staging` — ensure no cross-promote or key reuse in the PR.

jessica: final checklist: TF plan OK, k8s dry-run OK, IAM policy updated, canary set. I'll schedule promote at 16:30 UTC. @carl @mike please confirm by 16:05.

carl: confirming, will run plans and ping when done.

(Dev notes) devops-bot: remember to tag the rollout with `release/feature-sessions` and add a rollback playbook link: https://wiki.redwood/rollbacks/session-service
